title: [Project Chromata] Mixer/siphon/star hit boxes are very frustrating
summary: ### Game Project Chromata ### Report type bug ### Description The text below a mixer is included in its hitbox, and shouldn’t be. You normally want compact layouts, so this ends up meaning you have to click on the row below to get a mixer, and often can’t select a siphon or star without moving things. Actually, I’m not sold on the text below mixers. Perhaps it’d be better inside the circle. Submitted through the account-free feedback form. No private reply address was collected.
